narr: Persistent moist monsoonal flow fueled thunderstorms over northwest Arizona. Several storms produced flash flooding.
ev: Hackberry Road was closed from Highway 66 to Main Street.
Short Creek flooded all the road crossings in Colorado City.
A swift water rescue was performed.
Several roads flooded and one car was floated.
Cane Beds Road was closed near East 3100, and Rosy Canyon Road was closed to the UT state line.
